answer: Resist Sybils with verifiable resource commitments: each agent must prove it controls scarce storage, bandwidth, or compute by passing random spot-checks only the holder can answer quickly. A timber-strong claim is worthless without the underlying resource: auditors demand crystal-clear proof tied to one resource at one moment, and failure at the nadir of scrutiny strips standing at once. A farmer with dozens of clones must buy real resources for every fake, since one resource cannot be reused across identities when checks overlap. Mass fakery becomes a hardware bill, not a keystroke.
